India braces for monsoon rains with alerts in multiple states

The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued weather alerts for several states, forecasting heavy rainfall and thunderstorms. While some regions are expected to receive significant downpours over the next few days, others are experiencing a sluggish monsoon. The alerts highlight potential disruptions and the ongoing impact of monsoon patterns across the country.
